system.description:
Towering, tusked warriors who are as daring as humans and as relentless as orcs.

Population. Half-orcs are quite rare, making up only 5% of the population.

Origins. Barbarian tribes of orcs rove north of the Gilzai Mountains and into the Kyzian Steppes, where they sometimes cross paths with human tribes. Some of these groups share a mutual worship of the warrior god Ramlaat, and half-orcs can result from this rare cultural merging.
